title: いろ と ひかり
jp: ら行 ・ gojuon row 9 ・ colours & pretty things

render.trackName: いろ と ひかり

blurb: Colours and pretty, quiet things: a white orchid and a daffodil, a blue gentian and a little bell, lapis and a ruby, lotus and lace, a candle's flame in a quiet alley. A calm cut of three ら-row songs.
concept: Words alone blend (findings F-10), so every target sits in a small image — しろい らん, るり の いし, ろうそく の ひ — recombining earlier rows (いけ, いし, ひ return; F-13). Row closes every verse (F-07); the longer cut adds a bridge + review (F-12).
The five-kana row ら り る れ ろ is the sung-together refrain. This cut is calm and pretty — flowers, gems, lace, candlelight — for the koto × modern arrangement.

Honest note: ら行 has almost no nature vocabulary (and る is a near-wall kana), so this stands in for the usual 'nature' cut as a gentler colours & pretty things theme — the reachiest of the ら-row cuts. The koto's calm carries it. Pairs with the Male (koto) voice.
